- [x] `derive_copy`
  - `no_copy`
- [x] `derive_debug`

  - `no_debug`
- `derive_default`
  - `no_default`
- `derive_hash`

- `derive_partialord`
- `derive_ord`

  - `impl_partialeq`

## Examples

```rust,noplayground
# extern crate bindgen;
bindgen::builder()
    .header_contents("wrapper.h", "#include <time.h>")
    .derive_default(true)
    .allowlist_type("timespec");
```

```rust,noplayground
/* automatically generated by rust-bindgen 0.69.2 */

pub type time_t = ::std::os::raw::c_long;
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Debug, Default, Copy, Clone)]
pub struct timespec {
    pub tv_sec: time_t,
    pub tv_nsec: ::std::os::raw::c_long,
}

// <layout_tests>
```
